acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Ira tells us about a short-term therapy for trauma called CPT. Cognitive processing therapy was designed for survivors of sexual assault and is also used for veterans with PTSD symptoms. This week we hear the recordings of someone actually going through the therapy.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc:
Jaime Lowe begins CPT. Jaime was sexually assaulted thirty years ago, when she was thirteen, and she’s rarely articulated the details out loud—until now.
Jaime Lowe is a writer for the New York Times Magazine and the author of Mental, a memoir about bipolar disorder.
acts.title: Week One

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: After a difficult first week in therapy, Jaime starts to see progress.
acts.title: Week Two
